|lore=Sly, carnivorous beast which stalks the snow-packed tundra. Wampas frequently drag their prey to an ice cave for storage. They always prefer to devour their victims alive.
|game_text=✶ Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to marker sites. Characters defeated by this Wampa may be relocated to Wampa Cave instead of being eaten (opponent of victim chooses).

|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Wampa (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “*Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploy to any marker site. Defeated characters are eaten or relocated to Wampa Cave (opponent of victim chooses).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “✶ Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth sites. Deploys only to marker sites. Characters defeated by this Wampa may be relocated to Wampa Cave instead of being eaten (opponent of victim chooses).” '''What changed:''' “*Ferocity” → “✶ Ferocity”; “Deploy” → “Deploys only”; removed “any”; “site. Defeated characters are eaten or” → “sites. Characters defeated by this Wampa may be”; added “instead of being eaten”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 50. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Wampa]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
